concept: Step Functions: orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries
tests: Choosing a service to coordinate a multi-step workflow of several Lambdas with error handling, retries and visual tracking.
expected: AWS Step Functions — a state machine with built-in retries, catch, branching and visual step tracking. Triggers: "multi-step workflow", "several Lambda functions", "error handling, retries", "visual tracking".
why_not: SQS and SNS — messaging and fan-out without stateful orchestration; Lambda destinations only route a function's result, not a complex multi-step process.
